vtable_image: VTABLE: a vtable word of a `dyn`-carrying wide pointer addresses rustc's vtable allocation for its (source, principal) pair, laid out [drop_in_place, size, align, methods..] one 8-byte word per slot, read-only; the certified loads read its size (+8) and align (+16) words (ir_vtable_cells, ir_vtable_align_load)
encodings_refused: struct.53: its ptrwrap row does not decode as the reference does: at the word 0x0 the row images [0x0] and trust-ir's reference interpreter decodes [<fatptr<container_vtable> value>]
